dogecoin.text: @dogecoin_empire Being successful is objective to its relational context. Not a imperial measurement.

@dogecoin_empire If you need to have a career to be "successful," then that's the core issue.  So, no, men are not afraid of a successful woman.  The fallacy of women are the only ones who give up their careers during pregnancy, which is also a moot point.  I quit my job to take care of my wife.
